TerraMaster D1 SSD Plus
What to know

This enclosure is designed for users who want to turn an M.2 NVMe SSD into a fast external drive, making it a practical choice for high-speed file transfers, portable storage, or working with large media files. Its broad USB Type‑C and Thunderbolt compatibility also makes it suitable for use across a wide range of modern devices.
